measurement_limits: These are correctness and lifecycle runs, not controlled comparative performance benchmarks.
Worker total_ms excludes external unchanged verification and some WorkerPool/test-runner overhead.
RSS is sampled by worker PID over an entire run; a repeated PID peak cannot be assigned to a particular proof. Helper VM memory is excluded.
Metal staging peak is allocated temporary buffer data, not total driver/GPU/host memory.
Only segment Poseidon2 Merkle folds use Metal. Other native stages remain CPU; Groth16 wrapping is the pinned local emulated Linux/amd64 helper.
Cancelled and timed-out requests retain partial stage observations and never count as complete proofs.
No twenty-request stability recommendation, GPU hardware fault injection, speedup claim, or network acceptance is established.
